subject: Clarify: Azure concierge discount path + reseller channel evidence
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@helixai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP follow-up: Azure private offer — discount path and reseller split

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We circulated the details internally and have two quick asks that will determine how we shape the PO:

1) Concierge discount. The procurement team asked whether Redwood can offer a short-term onboarding/concierge discount that phases out over the first 6 months (we expect heavy ingestion and pilot costs). We need to understand the eligible SKU list and whether that discount is applied to list price or to the private-offer committed price.

2) Reseller channel passback. Our reseller (CloudBridge Partners) requires a formal channel margin confirmation and evidence (template) so their finance team can map the passback to their revenue recognition. Can you provide the template or an ops artifact that shows the passback calculation (tax handling, list price anchoring, and where commissions are withheld)?

Attached: Helix_RFP-summary.pdf (high-level usage profile).

Can you circle back with the eligible SKUs and a rough % headroom for the concierge discount by EOD Friday? We need the info for our internal approval.

Best,
Aisha Jones
Procurement Manager, HelixAI
procurement@helixai.com

--
Attachment: Helix_RFP-summary.pdf (1 page summary, 75KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@helixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: Azure private offer — discount path and reseller split

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the profile. Quick responses below and a proposed path: 

- Concierge discount: we can offer a time-limited onboarding discount (what we call a \"concierge credit\") that applies to the committed private-offer SKU rates (not list price), for up to 6 months. Typical structure: 15% off committed price for months 1–3, stepping to 7.5% months 4–6. We can tailor the bands to your usage profile.

- Eligible SKUs: we recommend anchoring credits to usage-metered token SKUs and ingestion (storage/transform) SKUs; we do not apply concierge credits to support line items or professional services. I'll attach a short SKU mapping and the private-offer workflow doc for your ops team.

- Channel passback: we have a standard channel_passback_template.xlsx that shows the worksheet (list price, committed PO price, reseller commission %, taxes, net remit). Important callouts: (a) passback is calculated on net revenue post-discounts, (b) taxes are treated per-country then grossed to the reseller's invoice, (c) any early-adopter credits (concierge) are treated as contra-revenue in month of usage. I attached that template and a one-pager explaining the calculation.

Next steps: if you confirm committed ARR band (e.g., $250k / $500k / $1M), I can run two scenarios with headroom and the final private-offer anchor price. Would you be able to confirm which band Helix expects to sign for by Thursday?

Attaching: redwood_privateoffer_workflow.pdf, channel_passback_template.xlsx

Thanks — cc'ing Ben to loop in channel/commission ops.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Deal Operations | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0219

--
Attachments: redwood_privateoffer_workflow.pdf, channel_passback_template.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RFP follow-up: Azure private offer — discount path and reseller split

Marissa — fyi, Helix is asking for a concierge discount + formal passback worksheet for CloudBridge. Irena has proposed the stepped 15%/7.5% model applied to committed SKUs.

Questions for pricing approval:
- Can we formally allow a 15% headroom on the committed-rate for initial onboarding for deals in the $250k–$1M ARR band?
- Do we need a one-off commission carveout for CloudBridge on the concierge credits (they're asking that passback reflect gross commissionable revenue)?

Irene: recommend including a short clause in the PO that concierge credits are contra-revenue and excluded from commissionable base unless we explicitly approve for ChannelBridge.

Please advise and I can push the scenarios to Helix.

Ben
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
